svg.text: DIR. S. BELMIROHA · SCENE 01: EXT ALLEY · NIGHT · PG 1/1

g.text: The alley swallows him. Four days of rain.
He walks towards camera. Dispatch in his ear.
The body. His shoes enter frame. He pauses.
Rack focus: his coat → the knot at the wrist.
Recognition lands. He knows this knot.
